title: OpenPocket App - App Store
excerpt: Download OpenPocket by Dolwin Fernandes on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips and more games like OpenPocket.
content_html:
Local AI in your pocket

Free · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS.

Local and private AI in your pocket: chat with local models, create images and dictate messages. A little intelligence. All yours. OpenPocket brings private AI conversations to your iPhone and iPad. Choose a model that suits your device, download it and explore your ideas without sending your conversation to a cloud AI service. FIND YOUR MODEL Browse a selection of 4-bit models, with guidance based on your device’s memory and storage. Manage your downloads and switch between installed models. KEEP YOUR TRAIN OF THOUGHT Ask questions, organise your thoughts and find the right words. Save conversations on your device, search them, rename them and pick up where you left off. BRING YOUR OWN WORDS AND IMAGES Import text, Markdown or text-based PDFs. Review and edit the extracted text before adding it to a conversation. With a compatible vision model, ask questions about a selected photo or screenshot. Images are resized for on-device processing. Input limits depend on the model, and scanned PDFs are not supported. LISTEN YOUR WAY Have responses read aloud using available system voices. Adjust the speaking rate, pause playback or stop whenever you like. LOCAL BY DESIGN No account, analytics or cloud conversation sync. Model downloads need an internet connection and enough free storage. Once a compatible model is installed, you can chat offline. You choose which conversations and models to keep. AI responses can be inaccurate or inappropriate. Check important information and use the flag beneath a response to prepare an optional report. Nothing is sent automatically. Model availability, speed, memory use and battery use vary by device. Larger models and longer conversations need more memory.

Ratings & Reviews

  • This app has not received enough ratings or reviews to display an overview.

1. Added experimental image generation with Stable Diffusion on supported devices. 2. Dictate messages, then review and edit your text before sending. 3. Attach photos from your library or take a photo directly in chat. Photo understanding requires a compatible vision model. 4. Improved background model downloads, download recovery, and progress updates. 5. The keyboard now dismisses when you send a message. 6. Reduced memory use during model preparation and improved device compatibility checks.
